# 2 Baruch Chapter 53 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**53:1** And when I had said these things, I fell asleep there, and I saw a vision in the night.

**53:2** And behold, a cloud was ascending from a very great sea, and I looked at it, and behold, it was full of waters both black and bright, and many colors were in it.

**53:3** And there were in it the likeness of great lightnings.

**53:4** And it came to pass when I had looked at it that the rain from that cloud rained down heavily upon the earth.

**53:5** And I saw that in the rain which fell there were both black and bright waters, and they were mingled together.

**53:6** And the bright waters were the more abundant, and they were purer than the black waters.

**53:7** Now the first portion was black water; and thereafter came bright water; and thereafter again black water; and thereafter again bright water.

**53:8** This was done twelve times, but the black waters were always the more numerous than the bright.

**53:9** And at the end of the cloud the black waters came down very greatly, and they were more gloomy than all those that had been before them, and fire was mixed with them, and where those black waters descended, devastation and famine came.

**53:10** And after these things I saw how that lightning which I had seen at the top of the cloud seized hold of the darkness which was there and cast it down to the earth.

**53:11** And that lightning shone exceedingly and it lit up the whole earth, and it healed those who were lying under the dark waters, and put out the fire.

**53:12** And it filled all the earth, and it had dominion over the black waters.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering arbitrated from EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA. Where translators diverged, SOPHIA selected the rendering best balancing accuracy, readability, and theological fidelity.*
